text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Bielefeld stood at 10.0 €/m², up 2.9 % year‑on‑year and 24.6 % over the last five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 8.75 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 11.52 €/m², while the asking premium over existing rents is 40 %.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 1.7 % and an average of 30 days on market; 23 % of listings are let within a week. Rent for a 60 m² unit is 600 € per month, giving a rent‑burden of 13.3 % for two residents.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.5 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 10.24 €/m² and 10.75 €/m², implying a 5.0 % increase.
